verdict.rationale: GitBook claims "Analytics & user feedback" as a plan feature. Its AI insights page shows what visitors ask and how well the Assistant answers from your content, which partly covers the search-term and failing-docs angle. One older hands-on community report says traffic stats count page loads and run 2-3x off versus Google Analytics, with inaccurate country data, so page-view figures carry a real accuracy caveat. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on page-view and traffic analytics, explicit search-term reporting for classic search, documentation of the reader-feedback mechanism, and current independent corroboration of analytics accuracy.
